title: Keep every interlocking registry entry in sync with its document

facts.note: The validator runs against the live registry and blocks at CONFIRM, whatever the diff contains.
Existence gate only: the registry exists in the repository and indexes at least one document. It does not need to be touched or read by the current plan.

fires: At CONFIRM, a registry entry's status differs from the status in the document it points at, even though nothing in the current change touched the registry or the document (a pre-existing mismatch).
At CONFIRM, after a planner added a registry entry for plan/_trains/_interlockings/<id>.yaml whose theme or surfaces differ from the document.
At CONFIRM, after a planner changed an interlocking document's status, theme or surfaces without updating its registry entry.
At CONFIRM, while the current change only edits unrelated plan files or non-mirrored document fields, but some indexed entry still disagrees on theme, status or surfaces.
doesNotFire: At CONFIRM, every registry entry's theme, status and surfaces equal the values in the document it points at (no finding, regardless of what changed).
Repositories with no interlocking registry plan/_trains/_interlockings.yaml.
Differences in document fields the registry does not mirror (anything other than theme, status, surfaces) — these are not compared; but such edits never exempt a mismatch on a mirrored field.

given: The interlocking registry (plan/_trains/_interlockings.yaml) indexes interlocking documents plan/_trains/_interlockings/<id>.yaml by path
when: the plan reaches CONFIRM, for every indexed entry, regardless of which files or fields the current change touched
then: every registry entry's theme, status and surfaces must equal the values in the document it points at.
prefer: Treat the document as authoritative: edit the document first, then copy theme, status and surfaces into the registry entry in the same change.
When a mismatch is found — including a pre-existing one your change did not cause — fix the registry entry to match the document, not the other way round.
avoid: Changing the document to match a stale registry entry — on disagreement the registry is always the defect.
Updating a document's status, theme or surfaces without updating its registry entry (or vice versa).
Treating an existing mismatch as out of scope because your change did not touch the registry or that document.
Adding fields to the registry that diverge from or are not sourced from the document.
why: The document is authoritative and the registry is only discovery metadata that denormalises theme, status and surfaces from it; any disagreement means the registry is lying to whoever discovers interlockings through it.
evidence: Validator test_interlocking_registry_coherence::test_live_registry_agrees_with_every_document_it_indexes passes at CONFIRM against the live registry (all entries, not only changed ones).
On failure, the report names interlocking_id, field, registry_value and document_value for each disagreement.
verifier_detail: Mirrored fields (term mirrored_field): theme, status, surfaces — fields the registry denormalises from the document it indexes.

Authoritative document (term authoritative_document): plan/_trains/_interlockings/<id>.yaml as named by the registry entry's path; on disagreement the document wins and the registry entry is reported as the defect.

Validation: family=coherence, template=cross_artifact_field_agreement, variant=planner_interlocking_registry_mirror, subject_kind=interlocking, phase=CONFIRM, enforcement=confirm-blocking. Checks every entry of the live registry, not a diff.
Failure evidence fields: interlocking_id, field, registry_value, document_value.

sharedNodes.text: strict: fails on every finding, no advisory mode, no ratchet baseline.

additions.text: No finding when all entries agree; no registry means nothing to check; non-mirrored fields are not compared but never exempt a mirrored mismatch.
additions.justification: Derived from the mirrored_field definition and the live-registry validator to make activation boundaries concrete; no new obligation or exemption.

additions.text: Edit the document first and copy mirrored fields into the registry in the same change.
additions.justification: Operationalises the source's 'document is authoritative' statement for planners; no new obligation beyond agreement.

additions.text: Treating an existing mismatch as out of scope; adding registry fields not sourced from the document.
additions.justification: Restates that the invariant covers every entry (S006) and that the registry is denormalised discovery metadata (S007); imposes no check beyond the mirrored fields.

trace.note: Unconditional invariant over every entry, checked at CONFIRM independent of the diff.
